# test/integration

`test/integration` validates `session.ts` lifecycle operations against real git repositories using Bun test runners.

## Contents

[lifecycle.test.ts](./lifecycle.test.ts) executes `startSession`, `abortSession`, and `listSessions` against temporary git repositories.

## Test Framework & Dependencies

`lifecycle.test.ts` imports `test`, `expect`, `describe`, `beforeEach`, `afterEach` from Bun test.
Helper functions `createTempRepo`, `removeTempRepo`, `addFileAndCommit` originate from `../helpers/temp-repo.ts`.
Tests invoke `startSession`, `endSession`, `abortSession`, `listSessions`, `resolveSession` from `../../src/session.ts`.
Manifest operations `loadManifest`, `listManifests` come from `../../src/manifest.ts`.
Git verification uses `branchExists` from `../../src/git.ts`.

## Behavioral Contracts

Branch naming convention follows `lanes/{sessionName}`.
`startSession` name validation rejects empty strings, path separators, shell metacharacters.
Manifest lifecycle creates manifests on `startSession` and deletes manifests on `abortSession`.
Duplicate session creation throws `already exists`.

## Setup & Teardown

`beforeEach` hooks initialize environments via `createTempRepo("lifecycle-test")`.
`afterEach` hooks clean up environments via `removeTempRepo(repoPath)`.
